raw_response:
This small plot of mine is only a tiny piece, less than a quarter acre, here in Pemba. I am an old man with no schooling, and money for shop fertilizer is scarce, so I will put the cow and goat manure I collect from home on it like I always do. The seed I will use is what I saved from last season, same as my neighbors, and I will weed it myself with my family. Rain from the sky is what waters my crop — I have no pump, no pipes, only my hands and God's help.
